user_query: I want to optimize my personal blog for better search engine rankings. Can you analyze the keyword density and provide recommendations for the top keywords and phrases? Additionally, fetch the sitemap XML for my blog and convert it into JSON format.

TaskList.description: Analyze the keyword density of the blog content and identify the top keywords and phrases.
Provide recommendations based on the keyword analysis results, including suggestions for improvement.
Fetch the sitemap XML of the blog.
Convert the fetched sitemap XML into JSON format.
